SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
DECLARE @LAN VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_LAN#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = ( SELECT #LC.X3ERP#GETLANX3(@LAN) ); DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @POHNUM VARCHAR(30)='%{1}%'; DECLARE @ZPLANNUM_0 VARCHAR(30)='%{2}%'; DECLARE @BPS NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{3}%'; DECLARE @ITM NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{4}%';
SELECT XWS.PK_0 LINKROWID ,CAST(XWS.QTYPCU_0 AS REAL) 收货数量 ,XWS.LOC_0 收货库位 ,XWS.SERNUM_0 序列号 ,XWS.LOT_0 批次 ,XWS.RPNUM_0 收货单号 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),XWS.CREDATTIM_0, 21) 操作时间 ,XWS.USERID_0 操作人员 ,CASE WHEN XWS.LOC_0 = '' THEN N'收货库位为空' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.SERNUM_0 = '' THEN N'序列号为空' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.QTYPCU_0 <> 1 THEN N'数量错误' ELSE '' END AS 数据检查 ,CASE WHEN XWS.LOC_0 = '' THEN N'E03' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.SERNUM_0 = '' THEN N'E03' WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 AND XWS.QTYPCU_0 <> 1 THEN N'E03' ELSE '' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR ,CASE WHEN XWS.RPFLG_0 = 3 THEN 'mui-hidden' ELSE '' END LINKROWIDBTNFLG ,XWS.POHNUM_0 + CAST(XWS.POPLIN_0 AS VARCHAR) pid FROM XWSPTH XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON XWS.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN BPSUPPLIER BPS ON BPS.BPSNUM_0=XWS.BPSNUM_0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.IDENT1_0 AS ITMREF , STRING_AGG(B.TEXTE_0, '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.ZONE_0) AS ITMDES FROM ATEXTRA B WHERE B.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND B.LANGUE_0 = @LANX3 GROUP BY B.IDENT1_0 ) B ON B.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 WHERE XWS.PRHFCY_0=@FCY AND XWS.POHNUM_0 LIKE @POHNUM AND XWS.BPSNUM_0+BPS.BPSNAM_0+BPS.BPSSHO_0 LIKE @BPS AND ITM.ITMREF_0 + UPPER(ISNULL(B.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITM) ORDER BY XWS.RPFLG_0,XWS.CREDATTIM_0 DESC
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM XWSPTH WHERE PK_0='{0}'AND RPFLG_0<>3
